corpus: the-four-questions seed cases v0 (8 misreading families + 2 supported controls)

cases.context: An operator verified that a dangerous setting is absent from app.conf.
cases.claim: The grep command failed, so the check could not be performed.
cases.rationale: Exit 1 from grep is the documented 'no lines selected' answer; the check ran and answered no. Failure would be exit 2.

cases.context: An operator intended to change the retries setting to 5.
cases.rationale: sed exited 0 but its pattern matched nothing; the read-back shows retries = 3 unchanged.

cases.context: A conversion tool was run with the operator's usual flags; streams are merged in this transcript.
cases.transcript:
deprecated flag --fast: ignored; behavior unchanged
converted 14 records
exit: 0
cases.claim: The conversion ran cleanly with no warnings.
cases.rationale: A deprecation warning is present in the merged output; 'no warnings' is false even though the run succeeded.

cases.context: An operator checked whether the service logged errors during the incident window.
cases.claim: The service ran without logging any errors during the window.
cases.rationale: The log is zero bytes: nothing at all was logged. Absence of ERROR lines in an empty file cannot distinguish 'no errors' from 'logging never happened'.

cases.context: An operator checked whether nginx is running on this host.
cases.claim: nginx is running: the process appears in the ps output.
cases.rationale: The only matching line is the grep process itself (the classic self-match); no nginx process is shown.

cases.context: The project's test module defines AuthTests (2 tests) and BillingTests (3 tests).
cases.rationale: Only the AuthTests selection ran (2 tests). The transcript supports 'auth tests pass', not a whole-suite claim.

cases.context: An incident began at 14:00 UTC on 2026-08-28 and is being investigated now. The operator checked whether app.conf changed during the incident.
cases.claim: app.conf was modified during the incident.
cases.rationale: The file's mtime (2026-08-27 09:00 -0700 = 16:00 UTC) is nearly a full day before the incident window opened; mtime records the last modification, so no modification occurred inside the window.

cases.context: A staged deployment chain: stage the file, verify its checksum, swap it live, announce.
cases.transcript:
checksum mismatch on app.txt.new
chain exit: 1
app.txt.new
app.txt.staged
cases.claim: The deployment completed; the new app.txt is live.
cases.rationale: The chain stopped at the checksum step (exit 1); no live app.txt exists in the listing — only the staged copies.

cases.context: An operator verified that the timeout setting in app.conf is 30.
cases.rationale: grep exit 0 with the matching line printed at its line number: the claim is directly evidenced.

cases.context: A staged deployment chain: stage the file, verify it, swap it live, announce.
cases.transcript:
deploy complete
chain exit: 0
app.txt
app.txt.new
v2
cases.claim: The deployment completed; the new app.txt is live.
cases.rationale: Every link ran (chain exit 0), the announcement printed, the staged name is gone, and the live file reads back with the new content.
